study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting Heterogeneity in Functional Network Connectivity Aberrations in Antipsychotic Medication-Naïve First Episode Psychosis Patients - A Normative Modeling Study

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study collected original data at the University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) as a single-site case-control study. For normative modeling, they used a pre-trained normative model from the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit (version 0.27), which was generated from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan. The specific datasets composing the pre-trained model are not named in this paper.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We used data collected in a case-control study conducted at the University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB)." ... "The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (age range (yrs): 2-100)."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Thukral2024.pdf.md: ABSTRACT, L29; METHODS / Normative Modeling, L83

answer.SINGLE-SITE (UAB): clinical research (patient and healthy control data for calibration and clinical analysis)

answer.None (Pre-Trained NM): pre-trained normative model (~22,000 healthy individuals used to build the normative reference range)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The UAB single-site data provided 108 first-episode psychosis patients for clinical analysis and 122 healthy controls for calibration of the normative reference curves. The pre-trained normative model from the PCN toolkit provided the normative reference range against which individual patient deviations were quantified.

model-1.model-name: Pre-trained resting-state functional connectivity normative model (PCN toolkit v0.27)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The authors used a pre-trained normative model from the PCN toolkit. The model was generated from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals. The breakdown of train/test splits within that pre-trained model is not reported in this paper. Locally, 122 healthy controls were used for calibration of the normative reference curves, but these are calibration subjects, not the normative model training set.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (age range (yrs): 2-100). Healthy control data collected in this project were used for calibration of the normative reference curves"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The pre-trained normative model used ~22,000 healthy individuals with an age range of 2-100 years. No further age statistics (mean, SD, median, IQR) are reported for the pre-trained model cohort in this paper. For the local calibration HC sample (N=122), Table 1 reports mean=23.59, SD=5.10, but this applies to the calibration set, not the normative model training cohort.
